high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "wintourworld," which is located in Milan, Italy. Person: The individual is wearing a long, flowing red dress with a bold, abstract pattern. The dress has a high neckline and long sleeves, and it is cinched at the waist with a belt. The person is also wearing a statement necklace with multiple strands and large beads, adding a touch of elegance to the outfit.
